# SDN_Neuromorphic_Interface

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A protocol layer that translates SDN flow-table updates into spike-based signals for neuromorphic processors embedded in network nodes. Bridges conventional SDN control with in-network neuromorphic computation, enabling event-driven, low-latency topology adaptation.
